component.name: Proton Meet
component.summary: Secure video conferencing that protects your privacy

description.p: This is a community package of Proton Meet and not officially supported by Proton AG.
Host and join secure, end-to-end encrypted video calls. Proton Meet protects your privacy and keeps your meetings confidential, backed by Switzerland's strict privacy laws.

ul.li: Host and join encrypted video and audio meetings with ease
Share your screen, windows, or browser tabs securely (Wayland-supported)
Communicate with end-to-end encryption to prevent unauthorized interception
Join directly without installing extra browser plugins
Enjoy a dark mode and sleek interface optimized for communication
Privacy First — We do not track or spy on your video calls. Your meetings, your business.
Easy to use — Simple, beautiful user interface that runs out-of-the-box.
Strong Encryption — Audio, video, and screen sharing are encrypted to ensure zero-access from third parties.
